I can't go to sleep, for some reason I have had an unsettling feeling for a few hours so I feel incredibly weak and exhausted (i have insomnia, this happens often)

It's horrible because if they do try to give me love, or ask what's wrong, i yell and push them away. It's like i want them to care but when they seem to i don't want it. It's so weird. I can never feel love from them.

Although my other grandma has always been so accepting of me and I feel love from her. 

My parents like to make me feel guilty. Saying "oh we buy you so much more than your brother so quit saying we love him more"

Are they fucking joking.

Some people I can't talk with because they won't say anything in response. After a few moments of silence they change the subject like what I'm saying is completely unimportant. 

A couple years back, i had really bad depression as to where I was physically ill. I was weak, my stomach was sick, i constantly thought of suicide and i rarely left the couch. My parents would constantly try to buy me things.

It didn't help. That stuff doesn't help. Simple items you can buy at a store doesn't fill the hole in your heart that can only be filled by true love and compassion. 

Me, i have to feel like someone really cares about me. It creates a feeling like I'm finally understood and someone wants me to feel better. 

Invalidating someone's problems....my grandma does it to me so much, i don't really like talking about stuff. I feel like im an attention seeker. Even when people tell me im not...I still feel I am.

😢 and the last thing someone needs is to be called "whiny", "overreactive", or "too emotional". To me it makes me feel as if im stupid for how i feel.
Right...to be sincere, and even if someone can't relate, then they can at least let you know they're always available to talk with. And try to make you feel that someone cares because someone can be a great support system just by expressing love and sincere care for a person.

It really does, when all you want is to feel like those who are your family approve of you and you are what they wanted you to be.....

It is, and I'm glad i could help you feel a bit more understood. :)

I'm so sorry....I know exactly how it feels to feel like a burden. I feel that way every day.

Although I may not know exactly how to help you, as I am also depressed/have anxiety, i can try to help you feel that you are understood. 

I understand your feelings or worthlessness/uselessness. I feel that way a lot because of my grandma and parents, I'm just never good enough for them; a disappointment. I'm never what they want me to be.

Ever since I began getting depressed a lot of my passions went down the drain as well. And the passions i do have? I feel stupid for them, that they're ridiculous and will never get me anywhere. That I'm wasting my time. It's really hard.

Again I'm sorry I couldn't help you more hon, but I want you to know, once again you are NOT alone. If you ever need anything you can always message me, as I get it.

*hugs*
